name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
genInstructions: Build the left turntable deck with a large central jog wheel, transport controls (play/pause, cue), a vertical tempo/pitch fader, sync and keylock toggles, loop controls, and a track info panel showing title, BPM, key, and elapsed/remaining time. This is the primary playback surface for the left channel track.
role: The left-hand playback engine that plays and manipulates one track and feeds its audio, position, and tempo to the mixer and waveform display.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user loads a highlighted track to Deck A, the browser sends the track's audio file, title, BPM, key, and duration; Deck A resets its playhead to the start, populates its info panel, and becomes ready to play.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
effectors.description: When the user clicks or drags on Deck A's waveform lane, the display emits the target time position; Deck A moves its playhead to that position (scrub/seek) and continues from there.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: When the user presses Sync on Deck B (with A as master), Deck B reads Deck A's current BPM and beat phase; conversely Deck A can consume B's BPM when A is the follower, aligning tempo and beatgrid.

effectors.name: DJ Table: FX & Performance Pads
effectors.description: When a pad assigned to Deck A is pressed, it sends a trigger (hot-cue jump, loop-roll length, or sample play) and Deck A responds by jumping to the cue point, engaging the loop, or playing the sample against its timeline.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck A continuously streams its decoded waveform, current playhead position, BPM, and beatgrid to the top lane of the display, which renders the scrolling waveform and moving playhead in real time.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: Deck A routes its live audio signal and level into mixer Channel A, and exposes its BPM; the mixer applies Channel A gain, EQ, filter, fader, and crossfader position to this signal before summing to master.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: When Deck A is the sync master and the user presses Sync on Deck B, Deck A supplies its BPM and beat phase so Deck B can match tempo and align beats.

name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
genInstructions: Build the right turntable deck mirroring Deck A: a large jog wheel, transport controls (play/pause, cue), a vertical tempo/pitch fader, sync and keylock toggles, loop controls, and a track info panel with title, BPM, key, and time. This is the primary playback surface for the right channel track.
role: The right-hand playback engine that plays and manipulates a second track and feeds its audio, position, and tempo to the mixer and waveform display.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user loads a highlighted track to Deck B, the browser sends the track's audio file, title, BPM, key, and duration; Deck B resets its playhead, populates its info panel, and becomes ready to play.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
effectors.description: When the user clicks or drags on Deck B's waveform lane, the display emits the target time position; Deck B moves its playhead to that position (scrub/seek) and continues from there.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: When Deck A is the sync master and the user presses Sync on Deck B, Deck B reads Deck A's BPM and beat phase and adjusts its own tempo fader value and beat phase to align.

effectors.name: DJ Table: FX & Performance Pads
effectors.description: When a pad assigned to Deck B is pressed, it sends a trigger (hot-cue jump, loop-roll length, or sample play) and Deck B responds by jumping to the cue point, engaging the loop, or playing the sample against its timeline.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck B continuously streams its decoded waveform, current playhead position, BPM, and beatgrid to the bottom lane of the display, which renders the scrolling waveform and moving playhead in real time.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: Deck B routes its live audio signal and level into mixer Channel B, and exposes its BPM; the mixer applies Channel B gain, EQ, filter, fader, and crossfader position to this signal before summing to master.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: When Deck B is the sync master and the user presses Sync on Deck A, Deck B supplies its BPM and beat phase so Deck A can match tempo and align beats.

name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
genInstructions: Build the central two-channel mixer with per-channel gain knobs, 3-band EQ (high/mid/low), filter knobs, vertical channel volume faders with VU meters, cue/PFL buttons, and a horizontal crossfader at the bottom, plus a master volume and master VU. This blends the two decks into the master output.
role: The central blending hub that receives both decks' audio, shapes and levels each channel, and crossfades them into the master output the DJ hears.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A feeds its live audio signal and level into Channel A; the mixer displays it on the Channel A VU meter and processes it through Channel A gain, EQ, filter, fader, and the crossfader before summing to master.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B feeds its live audio signal and level into Channel B; the mixer displays it on the Channel B VU meter and processes it through Channel B gain, EQ, filter, fader, and the crossfader before summing to master.

effectors.name: DJ Table: FX & Performance Pads
effectors.description: When an effect is armed and its wet/dry is engaged for a target channel or master, the FX unit sends the processed effect parameters; the mixer inserts the effect into that channel's signal path and reflects the change in its output and meters.

targets.name: DJ Table: FX & Performance Pads
targets.description: The mixer exposes which channel is selected/cued and its current level so the FX unit knows which channel signal to apply effects to; selecting a channel's FX-assign routes that channel's audio into the effect processor.

name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
genInstructions: Build a wide dual-lane scrolling waveform display across the top, one lane per deck, showing color-coded frequency waveforms, beatgrid markers, hot-cue markers, loop regions, and a fixed center playhead. Let the user click/drag a lane to scrub, and show beat-alignment between the two lanes.
role: The top-mounted visual monitor that renders both decks' tracks for beatmatching and lets the DJ scrub either deck by interacting with its lane.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A streams its decoded waveform, playhead position, BPM, and beatgrid, which the display renders in the top lane with a moving playhead and beat markers in real time.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B streams its decoded waveform, playhead position, BPM, and beatgrid, which the display renders in the bottom lane with a moving playhead and beat markers in real time.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: When the user clicks or drags within the top lane, the display emits the corresponding time position and Deck A seeks its playhead to that point.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: When the user clicks or drags within the bottom lane, the display emits the corresponding time position and Deck B seeks its playhead to that point.

name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
genInstructions: Build a bottom track library browser with a searchable, sortable track list (title, artist, BPM, key, duration), folder/playlist tree, a search bar, and Load-to-Deck-A / Load-to-Deck-B buttons. This is where the DJ finds and loads music onto the decks.
role: The music source that lets the DJ search and browse the collection and load a chosen track onto either deck.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: When the user selects a track and presses Load to Deck A, the browser sends that track's audio file, title, BPM, key, and duration to Deck A, which loads it and readies playback.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: When the user selects a track and presses Load to Deck B, the browser sends that track's audio file, title, BPM, key, and duration to Deck B, which loads it and readies playback.

name: DJ Table: FX & Performance Pads
genInstructions: Build a performance section with two banks of 8 velocity-style pads (one per deck) for hot cues, loop rolls, and sampler triggers, plus an effects unit with selectable effect types, wet/dry and parameter knobs, beat-division selectors, and per-deck/master assign toggles.
role: The hands-on performance layer that triggers cues, loops, and samples on the decks and applies real-time effects to the mixer channels or master.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
effectors.description: The mixer tells the FX unit which channel is currently selected/FX-assigned so the effect processor knows which channel signal to operate on; the assign state determines the effect's routing target.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Pressing a Deck A pad sends a trigger to Deck A: hot-cue pads jump the playhead to stored cue points, loop-roll pads engage a beat-length loop, and sampler pads play a one-shot against Deck A's timeline.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Pressing a Deck B pad sends a trigger to Deck B: hot-cue pads jump the playhead to stored cue points, loop-roll pads engage a beat-length loop, and sampler pads play a one-shot against Deck B's timeline.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: When an effect is engaged with a channel or master assign, the FX unit sends the effect type, wet/dry level, beat-division, and parameters, and the mixer inserts the effect into that channel/master signal path.
